```yaml
name: SCCache Warmup

on:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  warmup:
    name: Warm up SCCache
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: "!github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [ubuntu-x86_64, ubuntu-arm64, windows-x86_64, macos-x86_64, macos-arm64]
        include:
          - platform: ubuntu-x86_64
            os: ubuntu-20.04
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - platform: ubuntu-arm64
            os: ubuntu-20.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - platform: windows-x86_64
            os: windows-2019
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - platform: macos-x86_64
            os: macos-11
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - platform: macos-arm64
            os: macos-11
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Setup sccache
        uses: mozilla-actions/sccache-action@v0.0.4
        with:
          gcp_credentials: ${{ secrets.GCP_WALRUS_RELEASE_BUCKET_SVCUSER_CREDENTIALS }}
          bucket_name: walrus-sccache
          location: us-west1

      - name: Build debug (with backup feature)
        run: |
          cargo build --workspace --features "walrus-service/backup"

      - name: Build release
        run: |
          cargo build --release

      - name: Post sccache stats
        run: |
          echo "Cache hits: $(sccache --show-stats | grep -E 'cache hits' | awk '{print $3}')"
          echo "Cache misses: $(sccache --show-stats | grep -E 'cache misses' | awk '{print $3}')"
          echo "Cache hit rate: $(sccache --show-stats | grep -E 'cache hit rate' | awk '{print $4}')"

  notify-failure:
    name: Notify on Failure
    needs: warmup
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Dispatch failure notification
        uses: peter-evans/repository-dispatch@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: MystenLabs/sui-operations
          event-type: sccache-warmup-failed
          client-payload: '{"workflow": "${{ github.workflow }}", "job": "${{ github.job }}", "run_id": "${{ github.run_id }}"}'
```
